name: admit-subject
description: The IT's admitSubject envelope goes through upsertPatient (PatientService) and createEpisode (EHRService) and comes back as admitSubjectResponse: the Episode with generated ids, startDate as a date and endDate + 5 days, plus the fixed Bill (100 / 5 / 500 / ADMITTED). Bill children follow the flow's DataWeave (initialStateEstimate), not the hand-written reply.xml (initialStayEstimate).
